sources: Google Maps place 'Fort Vermilion Bridge Campground' (read 2026-11-11)

values.note: Non-serviced overnight sites C$30 a night plus GST; day use free. Leaving after the 2 pm check-out time adds another night's charge.

fees.source: Mackenzie County parks and recreation page https://www.mackenziecounty.com/parksandrecreation (redirected from mackenziecounty.com/campgrounds/; read 2026-11-11): 'Day Use: No Charge', 'Overnight (Non-Serviced): $30.00 + GST'; Let's Camp camp record and site list (letscamp.ca/api/camps/fortvermilionbridge and /api/camps/6790f212b01821878ab16757/sites, read 2026-11-11): rules 'An additional overnight charge shall apply to campers who check out after 2:00pm'

values.note: Booked on Mackenzie County's Let's Camp page or through the county's Fort Vermilion office; there is no caretaker on site. A booking is cancelled without refund if the camper does not check in within 24 hours of arrival time. Check-in 4 pm, check-out 2 pm.

booking.source: Mackenzie County parks and recreation page https://www.mackenziecounty.com/parksandrecreation (redirected from mackenziecounty.com/campgrounds/; read 2026-11-11): 'There is no caretaker on site, please use online booking or contact Fort Vermilion Office.'; Let's Camp camp record and site list (letscamp.ca/api/camps/fortvermilionbridge and /api/camps/6790f212b01821878ab16757/sites, read 2026-11-11): 'Check in time is 4:00PM Check out time is 2:00PM', 'No person shall camp for more than fourteen (14) consecutive days in the same campsite.', 'A camping permit is automatically cancelled and no refund is issued if the Parks Officer does not receive notification ... within 24 consecutive hours of the check in time'

values.note: Open from mid-May (no exact date posted) to September 30.

season.source: Mackenzie County parks and recreation page https://www.mackenziecounty.com/parksandrecreation (redirected from mackenziecounty.com/campgrounds/; read 2026-11-11): 'This overnight campground is open from mid-May to September 30.'

hookups.source: Mackenzie County parks and recreation page https://www.mackenziecounty.com/parksandrecreation (redirected from mackenziecounty.com/campgrounds/; read 2026-11-11): 'Overnight (Non-Serviced)'; Let's Camp camp record and site list (letscamp.ca/api/camps/fortvermilionbridge and /api/camps/6790f212b01821878ab16757/sites, read 2026-11-11): no site lists power, water or sewer

sites.source: Let's Camp camp record and site list (letscamp.ca/api/camps/fortvermilionbridge and /api/camps/6790f212b01821878ab16757/sites, read 2026-11-11): 20 numbered sites (1-20), every one for 'rv' and 'tent' with maxRvLength 40 ft; sites 12, 17 and 19 marked pullThrough (the old Alberta Parks page said 10)

note: Mackenzie County overnight campground just off Hwy 88 on the north side of the Peace River, by the Fort Vermilion bridge near the hamlet of Fort Vermilion, with a boat launch; no caretaker on site. --Claude
summary: Mackenzie County page + Let's Camp: C$30 + GST non-serviced, mid-May to Sep 30, 20 sites (was 10) up to 40 ft, Let's Camp booking, 14-night max. Alberta Parks page still 404; ownership provincial -> local is a candidate. Not waterfront confirmed.
flags: OWNERSHIP (candidate provincial -> local): Alberta Parks' Fort Vermilion PRA pages answer 404 (park and camping URLs probed 2026-11-11) and the site search finds nothing; Mackenzie County lists, prices and books it as its own 'Fort Vermilion Bridge Campground' under its Municipal Parks Bylaw 1317-24 (Let's Camp rules: 'Rules and Regulations as per Municipal Parks Bylaw 1317-24'). The stored note's 'operated under lease by Mackenzie County' could not be confirmed; the county page states a lease only for La Crete Ferry. Reviewer's call.

WEBSITE: letscamp.ca/camps/fortvermilionbridge answers (API 200, 'Fort Vermilion Bridge Campground') and is this campground; suggest adding https://www.mackenziecounty.com/parksandrecreation (200, the county's campground section with the rate) as the first line.

PHONE: stored 780-927-2507 matches the county's 'Call the Caretaker: 780-927-2507'. The county's Fort Vermilion office (the page says to contact it, no caretaker on site) is 780-927-3718, which is also Google's phone.
Google Maps: 3.5 from 18 reviews (public campground; the private-park review rule does not apply).
WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed - the site loop is ~200 m north of the Peace River through continuous forest on Esri imagery.
